hero.title: Amazon FBA fee and profit calculator
hero.subtitle: Estimate per-unit profit and margin using your own sale price, COGS, referral fee, FBA fulfillment, and other costs.

intro: This calculator does not embed live Amazon fee tables. Enter fee estimates from Seller Central (Revenue Calculator or fee preview) so results stay under your control.

instructions.title: Pull fees from Seller Central
instructions.body: Open the Amazon Revenue Calculator or your category fee schedule and note referral percent and FBA fulfillment for the size tier.

instructions.title: Enter price and landed cost
instructions.body: Use the planned sale price and your true landed COGS, including duties where they apply.

instructions.title: Allocate optional costs
instructions.body: Add inbound shipping, storage, advertising, and other costs on a per-unit basis for a realistic margin.

instructions.title: Review profit and break-even
instructions.body: Check profit per unit, margin, and break-even sale price before you commit to a list price.

assumptions.title: Seller-provided fees
assumptions.body: Referral percent, FBA fulfillment, and other Amazon fees are estimates you enter. They are not fetched from Amazon and are not guaranteed current.

assumptions.title: Per-unit model
assumptions.body: All inputs are treated as costs for a single unit sold. Volume discounts and monthly storage minimums are not modeled.

assumptions.title: Referral on sale price
assumptions.body: Referral fee is calculated as a percent of sale price. Confirm whether your category uses a different basis in Seller Central.

assumptions.title: Not tax advice
assumptions.body: Sales tax, VAT, and income tax are excluded. Use your accountant for filing decisions.

tips.title: Negative profit
tips.body: Raise price, cut ads, or renegotiate COGS before sending more inventory to FBA.

tips.title: Thin margin
tips.body: Leave room for returns, storage spikes, and PPC tests when margin is under 15%.

tips.title: Fee changes
tips.body: Re-run the calculator whenever Amazon updates size tiers or referral rates for your category.
